tables.title: Double Qaimaqamate of Mount Lebanon, 1843 to 1861 (description, approximate region)

rows.statement: Mount Lebanon was administered as two districts after 1843: a northern, mostly Christian district under a Christian qaim-maqam, and a southern, mixed district under a Druze qaim-maqam (Ahmad Arslan appointed to the south, Haydar Ahmad Abu al-Lama' to the north). Each qaim-maqam had two wakils, one Druze and one Christian, with judicial and fiscal authority over their own community.
The division was proposed by Austrian Chancellor Metternich as a compromise among Ottoman, British and French positions; the Sultan agreed on 1 December 1843.
An 1844 map cited on the source page shows the Nahr al-Kalb as the northern boundary of the Druze district. The exact boundary is not given in the text, so no polygon is drawn.
The arrangement ended after the 1860 conflict; the Mount Lebanon Mutasarrifate followed in 1861.

tables.note: Description only, paraphrased from the cited page. Region approximate; no polygons. Dates as the page gives them (1843 to 1861; sometimes cited as 1842).

tables.title: Greater Lebanon: counts by sect, 1922 and 1932 (Chamie 1981)
tables.source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greater_Lebanon (table 'Religion in Lebanon according to censuses'; cites Chamie 1981 p. 29 and Maktabi 1999)
tables.license: Wikipedia contributors, CC BY-SA 4.0 (facts only; table values as cited there)
tables.note: The 1922 count is the French Mandate census of 1921-22 (Wikipedia dates it 1922). Blank 1922 cells are not broken out in the source, not zero: only Maronite, Melkite, Syriac Catholic, Greek Orthodox, Sunni, Shia and Druze are listed, and Christians total 355,668, Muslims 229,733. 1932 totals differ by source (this table 785,543; Maktabi table 793,396 residents): see the next two tables. Source arithmetic: the listed 1932 rows sum to 785,813 (270 above the printed total); the listed 1922 rows sum to 609,034, and the printed 1922 Christian total (355,668) is 20,000 above its listed rows, so the printed 629,034 includes 20,000 not itemised.
